title: Northgate+ Business Return Reversal of Northgate Cash
content:
Under Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the Business return reversal schedule settles the Northgate Cash taken back on one return: the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first, when the member holds a Northgate+ Business membership, and only for that return. Its result is a reversal booked against the earning of the returned line, lowering the membership's Northgate Cash balance, which may go below zero.

### The reversal tool

`reverse_business_return_cash_4d4108b5` reverses the Northgate Cash a Northgate+ Business member earned on an order line the business returned for a refund. One call books one reversal entry on the membership's Northgate Cash ledger, linked to the earning it reduces and to the order return record that caused it, and lowers the membership's Northgate Cash balance by the amount reversed (the balance may go below zero). The member sees the reversal in their Northgate Cash history and the lower balance.

It is an agent-side tool, unlocked by the agent and then called; the call succeeds when the receipt reports status "reversed".

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the membership record whose Northgate Cash is reduced, as returned by the membership lookup for the member | identifier |
| `earning_event_id` | the Northgate Cash earning entry being reduced, as returned by the membership ledger lookup | ledger entry identifier |
| `source_order_event_id` | the return record that caused the reversal, as returned by the order ledger lookup | order ledger identifier |
| `order_id` | the Northgate order the returned line belongs to, as returned by the order lookup | identifier |
| `return_date` | the date the return was processed | YYYY-MM-DD, no time part, no time zone; never empty |
| `refunded_merchandise_usd` | the merchandise amount the return refunded | US dollars, positive, 2 decimal places; more decimals refused, never rounded by the tool |
| `amount_usd` | the Northgate Cash reversed | US dollars, positive, 2 decimal places; more decimals refused, never rounded by the tool |

**Receipt.** "Northgate Cash reversal <reversal_ref> booked: membership <membership_id>, earning <earning_event_id>, return <source_order_event_id>, order <order_id>, dated <return_date>, refunded merchandise <refunded_merchandise_usd> USD, amount <amount_usd> USD, new balance <balance> USD, status reversed." — the reversal reference is the new entry's reference, amounts are two-decimal US dollars and the balance after the reversal may be negative.

**Refusals.** A text beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked because an argument broke the formats above, the membership's tier is outside this reversal (any tier other than Northgate+ Business), the record is not the member's most recent return on their Northgate orders, the earning given is not the earning of the returned line, or the membership reference is unknown.
